title: About
text:
Hey! My name is Ivan Romero. I was born and raised in Long Beach, California and I am the youngest of 5. I am currently a 4th year Biology major at UC Riverside with dreams of becoming a cardiologist one day.
On campus I serve as a Pre-Professional Advising Center Ambassador and am a part of the Medical Scholars Program. I will be taking the MCAT in January 2027 and plan to apply to medical school in the next cycle.
When I’m not studying, you can find me running, hiking, or on the golf course. I love spending time with my family and trying new foods — my current favorite spot is Shawarma House in Garden Grove, highly recommend!
Feel free to check out my Portfolio to see some of my coursework!
